sponsoredBills.title: Reverse Big Ugly Tax Breaks for Data Centers Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, and in addition to the Committees on House Administration, the Judiciary, and Ways and Means, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends federal ethics laws to prohibit covered federal officials, including Members of Congress, judges, and top executive branch appointees, from owning or trading securities, commodities, and futures. Requires divestiture within 90 days and establishes penalties including fines and profit disgorgement for violations.
sponsoredBills.title: No Profiting from Public Service Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Agriculture.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Agricultural Marketing Act of 1946 to establish the Local Foods for Healthy Schools Program, directing the Secretary of Agriculture to enter into cooperative agreements with eligible state units of government to purchase local foods from covered producers and distribute them to participating schools.
sponsoredBills.title: Local Foods for Healthy Schools Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committee on Education and Workforce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.summary: Prohibits the sale of gasoline and petroleum distillates at unconscionably excessive prices during military operations against Iran beginning in March 2026 until the President certifies operations have ceased and the Strait of Hormuz has reopened. Establishes Federal Trade Commission and state enforcement mechanisms with civil and criminal penalties.
sponsoredBills.title: Lower Prices at the Pump Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to increase the earned income tax credit for parents of young children under age 4, with higher credit percentages and phaseout adjustments, and allows monthly payment options for resulting refunds.
sponsoredBills.title: Working Parents Tax Relief Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Armed Services.

sponsoredBills.summary: Expands personalized financial and housing counseling for active-duty military members and those transitioning from service by requiring the Secretary of Defense to establish a program providing one-on-one counseling on credit management, budgeting, home loans, and related topics.
sponsoredBills.title: Military Financial Literacy Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure.

sponsoredBills.summary: Establishes a $5.5 billion annual bridge improvement formula program distributing funds to states based on poor-condition bridge replacement costs, and creates a $150 million regional transportation planning program. Modifies highway safety improvement funding allocations to prioritize smaller urbanized and rural areas.
sponsoredBills.title: BASICS Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Nutrition and Foreign Agriculture.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Food and Nutrition Act of 2008 to expand benefits for households receiving federal or state energy assistance by making them eligible for standard utility allowances and treating energy assistance payments as household income and expenses.
sponsoredBills.title: Affordable Food and Energy Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on General Farm Commodities, Risk Management, and Credit.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Farm Credit Act of 1971 to expand rural housing financing by including accessory dwelling units as eligible property improvements and increasing the acreage threshold from 2,500 to 10,000 acres for qualifying rural properties.
sponsoredBills.title: FARM Home Loans Act of 2025

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

sponsoredBills.summary: Requires the Government Accountability Office to study barriers to accessing the Child Care and Development Block Grant program, including impacts of state income eligibility limits, wait lists, payment rates, and inflation on child care availability and affordability.
sponsoredBills.title: Child Care Access and Affordability Act of 2025

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Water Resources and Environment.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to increase financial assistance available through state water pollution control revolving loan funds to rural, small, and tribal publicly owned treatment works, allowing states to provide up to 50 percent of capitalization grants as subsidies and requiring minimum subsidy levels.
sponsoredBills.title: Affordable Clean Water Infrastructure Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to allow qualified child care expenses for children under age 5 to be treated as qualified expenses under section 529 education savings plans, including expenses paid to licensed or regulated child care providers.
sponsoredBills.title: Early Education Savings Program Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Violence Against Women Act Reauthorization Act of 2022 to include identity theft within the local law enforcement grant program for cybercrime enforcement, and defines identity theft for purposes of that program.
sponsoredBills.title: Protect Your PIN Act of 2025

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Economic Development, Public Buildings, and Emergency Management.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Stafford Disaster Relief Act to require reimbursements for emergency work to be disbursed within 120 days after a reimbursement request if at least 90 percent of estimated costs are eligible.
sponsoredBills.title: Rapid Disaster Relief Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, and in addition to the Committees on Education and Workforce, Oversight and Government Reform, and Armed Services, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.summary: Requires the Secretary of Labor to maintain a publicly available list of employers that relocate call centers or contract call center work overseas, making such companies ineligible for Federal grants or guaranteed loans for five years, and requires business entities to disclose the physical location of agents providing customer service communications.
sponsoredBills.title: Keep Call Centers in America Act of 2025

latestAction.text: Referred to the Subcommittee on Coast Guard and Maritime Transportation.

sponsoredBills.summary: Requires the Coast Guard Commandant to submit a strategy within 90 days for completing design and construction of a Great Lakes icebreaker and to conduct a five-year pilot program measuring the fleet's capability to keep specified waterways open 95 percent of ice seasons.
sponsoredBills.title: Great Lakes Icebreaker Act of 2025

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Armed Services.

sponsoredBills.summary: Requires the Secretary of Defense to submit annual reports to Congress on funding and status of Department of Defense interim remedial actions relating to perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), submit a PFAS remediation acceleration strategy, and establish a public online dashboard tracking PFAS actions at military installations.
sponsoredBills.title: the Military PFAS Transparency Act of 2025
